# Dr. Anjani Dixit — Laparoscopic Surgeon & IVF Specialist, Bangalore

## About
Dr. Anjani Dixit is a fellowship-trained laparoscopic gynaecological surgeon, IVF and fertility specialist, and obstetrician based in Indiranagar, Bangalore, India. She has over 14 years of clinical experience and has performed more than 1500 gynaecological procedures. She holds a 5.0 Google rating with 420 verified patient reviews.

## Qualifications
- MBBS — IPGME&R and SSKM Hospital, Kolkata
- DNB — Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Holy Family Hospital, New Delhi
- FMAS — Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery
- Reproductive Medicine Certification — Indian College of Obstetrics and Gynaecology (ICOG)
- Life Member: FOGSI (Federation of Obstetric and Gynaecological Societies of India), AMASI, ASI
- Member: AOGD
- Medical Registration: DLH 2013 0000613KTK (Karnataka Medical Council)

## Specialties
- Advanced laparoscopic surgery: fibroids (myomectomy), endometriosis excision, ovarian cysts, hysterectomy (TLH/LAVH), diagnostic laparoscopy, adhesiolysis
- IVF and fertility treatment: IVF, IUI (intrauterine insemination), fertility evaluation, ovulation induction, surgical fertility treatment, recurrent pregnancy loss
- Obstetrics and pregnancy care: antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy management, PCOS in pregnancy, thyroid in pregnancy, normal delivery and LSCS, postnatal care
- PCOS / PCOD management: cycle regulation, hormonal balance, metabolic management, fertility with PCOS, long-term monitoring
- Cosmetic gynaecology: labiaplasty, vaginal rejuvenation, hymenoplasty, perineal repair (perineoplasty), PRP therapy, vaginoplasty
